github_description: Connect your GitHub account and install the CoForge App on your account or organization.
github_unconfigured: GitHub is not configured in this environment yet.
github_expired: Your GitHub authorization is no longer valid. Re-authenticate to continue.
github_disconnect_help: Disconnect removes your saved credentials from CoForge. It does not uninstall the GitHub App.
github_error: GitHub could not complete this request. Retry, or check your authorization and repository access.
github_callback_error: GitHub authorization was cancelled or could not be verified. Try connecting again.
github_wrong_account: This is a different GitHub account. Re-authenticate with the connected account.
github_pending_installation: GitHub is connected, but the CoForge App still needs access to an account or organization.
github_no_installations: No accessible installations. Install the App for your repositories, or ask your organization owner to approve access.
github_no_repositories: No repositories on this page. Configure repository access or return to the previous page.
settings_user_description_placeholder: Tell your teammates what you work on.
settings_avatar_help: JPG, PNG, or WebP. 5 MB maximum.
settings_profile_save_error: The profile could not be saved. Your changes are still here; try again.
settings_profile_save_partial_error: Your profile image was updated, but the name or description could not be saved. Your text changes are still here; try again.
settings_avatar_save_error: The profile image could not be updated. Your changes are still here; try again.
preferences_time_zone_search_placeholder: Search by city, time zone, or UTC offset…
notifications_push_description: DMs, @mentions, and new messages in unmuted channels.
preferences_browser_notifications_blocke: Blocked by the browser. Allow it in site settings.
preferences_browser_notifications_unsupp: Notifications are not supported by this browser.
notifications_push_unconfigured: Push notifications are not configured for this workspace.
preferences_browser_notifications_save_e: Browser notifications could not be updated. Try again.
preferences_browser_notifications_test_e: The test notification could not be sent. Check this browser's permission and try again.
notifications_home_screen_title: Add CoForge to your Home Screen
notifications_home_screen_description: On iPhone and iPad, CoForge can receive notifications after it is installed as a Home Screen app.
notifications_home_screen_share: Tap Share in the Safari toolbar.
notifications_home_screen_open: Open CoForge from its new Home Screen icon, then return here to turn on notifications.
settings_save_error: The preference could not be saved. Try again.
preferences_live_agent_activity_hint: Show the latest agent status at the bottom of the chat list.
preferences_open_newest_read: Start at the newest message and mark it read
preferences_open_first_unread: Start at the oldest unread message
preferences_open_newest_unread: Start at the newest message but keep it unread
